name: Roth 403(b) vs. Traditional 403(b) Calculator
meta_description: Compare Roth and traditional 403(b) deferrals after tax, with 2026 limits, the 15-year catch-up for school and hospital staff, and the Roth catch-up rule.
subtitle: Compare what Roth and pre-tax 403(b) deferrals leave you after tax at retirement, using your 2026 limit including the 15-year service catch-up and age-based catch-ups.
